n8n.whatItDoes: n8n is an open-source workflow automation tool that connects 400+ apps, APIs, and AI models. Unlike Zapier or Make, you can self-host it — meaning your data never leaves your servers, and you never hit usage-based pricing walls.
howWeUseIt: AI agent orchestration — connecting Vapi voice agents to CRM, calendar, and databases
Lead routing workflows — inbound leads scored, enriched, and routed in real-time
Data sync pipelines — keeping CRM, accounting, and project management in sync

Scheduled reports — automated daily/weekly performance reports delivered to your inbox
Error monitoring — self-healing workflows with Slack/email alerts on failures
n8n.whyNotDIY: n8n is powerful but has a steep learning curve. Building reliable, production-grade workflows requires understanding error handling, retry logic, data transformation, and API authentication patterns. We've built 200+ n8n workflows and know the pitfalls.

faqs.q: Should I self-host or use n8n Cloud?
faqs.a: For most businesses, we recommend self-hosting on a $20/month VPS. You get unlimited executions, full data control, and no per-workflow pricing. We set up and maintain the server for you.

faqs.q: How does n8n compare to Zapier?
faqs.a: n8n is more powerful and dramatically cheaper at scale. Zapier charges per task (can reach $500+/month for heavy users). n8n self-hosted has no per-task limits. The trade-off: n8n requires more technical skill to set up, which is where we come in.

faqs.q: Can n8n handle AI workflows?
faqs.a: Yes. n8n has native nodes for OpenAI, Anthropic, local LLMs, and custom AI models. We build AI chains, RAG pipelines, and agent orchestration on n8n.

faqs.q: Is n8n reliable for production use?
faqs.a: Absolutely. With proper error handling, queue management, and monitoring (which we implement), n8n handles millions of executions per month reliably.

faqs.q: Do you provide ongoing n8n support?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer management plans starting at $197/month covering monitoring, updates, new workflow builds, and priority support.
